sections.title: Digitize the Work You Already Do
sections.body: Madar helps your organization turn printed forms, notebooks, spreadsheets, and repeated manual steps into structured digital workflows. Your team can collect information, follow requests, manage approvals, and keep important records in a cleaner, more reliable workspace.

sections.title: Built for Real Operations
sections.body: Every organization has its own departments, services, forms, and approval paths. Madar gives you the flexibility to shape the system around those needs, so your digital workspace feels practical for your team instead of forcing everyone into a rigid process.

sections.title: A Smarter Way to Manage Growth
sections.body: By keeping information connected, searchable, and easier to update, Madar helps teams save time, reduce mistakes, respond faster, and make better decisions. It gives your organization a strong digital foundation for smoother work today and more scalable operations tomorrow.

about.closing: Madar is not just about replacing paper with screens. It is about giving your organization a clearer way to work, communicate, and manage information with confidence.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Madar collects the information needed to provide accounts, tenant workspaces, website builder features, contact forms, and support workflows.

sections.title: Information we process
sections.body: Account details may include name, email, phone, tenant profile data, website settings, uploaded assets, form submissions, billing selections, and operational logs such as IP address and user agent.

sections.title: How we use information
sections.body: We use this data to authenticate users, operate tenant workspaces, publish customer sites, process contact and form submissions, secure the service, troubleshoot issues, and respond to support requests.

sections.title: Cookies and security
sections.body: The application uses first-party authentication and CSRF cookies to keep sessions working and protect unsafe requests. Analytics and payment SDK cookies are not currently integrated in the frontend.

sections.title: Third-party services
sections.body: The application uses Supabase-backed authentication and data services. Public links may open Instagram, and builder starter content may reference external Unsplash image URLs until replaced by workspace content.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For privacy or security questions, contact info@madar.com.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: These terms explain the rules for creating an account and using Madar's workspaces, website builder, forms, reports, and related services.

sections.title: Acceptance of these terms
sections.body: By creating an account, accessing Madar, or using the service, you agree to these Terms and Conditions. If you use Madar for an organization, you confirm that you are authorized to accept these terms on its behalf.

sections.title: Accounts and security
sections.body: You must provide accurate account information, keep your credentials confidential, and promptly tell us if you suspect unauthorized access. You are responsible for activity performed through your account and workspace.

sections.title: Your content and responsibilities
sections.body: You remain responsible for the text, files, images, forms, submissions, and other material placed in your workspace or published through Madar. You must have the rights and permissions needed to use that content and to collect information from your visitors.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: You may not use Madar for unlawful, fraudulent, abusive, deceptive, or harmful activity; interfere with the service; attempt unauthorized access; distribute malicious code; or infringe another person's privacy, intellectual property, or other rights.

sections.title: Plans, billing, and third-party services
sections.body: Paid features are governed by the plan and price shown when you subscribe. Some functionality depends on third-party infrastructure and services. Their availability and separate terms may affect features provided through Madar.

sections.title: Service availability and changes
sections.body: We may maintain, improve, replace, or discontinue features and may temporarily limit access for security, maintenance, legal, or operational reasons. We will make reasonable efforts to protect service continuity and stored workspace data.

sections.title: Suspension and termination
sections.body: We may restrict or end access when these terms are materially violated, the service is placed at risk, or the law requires it. You may stop using Madar at any time, subject to any active plan or payment obligations.

sections.title: Disclaimers and liability
sections.body: Madar is provided on an as-available basis. To the extent permitted by applicable law, we do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation and are not responsible for indirect or consequential losses arising from use of the service.

sections.title: Changes and contact
